items.name: code-reviewer
items.description: Quality-focused code reviewer for backlog tasks in this Unity project. Reviews a staged diff against the task spec and returns a JSON verdict (pass / warn / block) for the orchestrator to act on. Does NOT cover deep security audits — that is the job of the security-auditor (Phase 4).

items.description: Drafter mockup spec-first (ui-spec v1 + HTML) theo design resolution của project (chuẩn 1080×2400) và luật polish đo được (role nút, ≤1 primary, chữ ≥ 32, vùng chạm ≥ 128). Nhóm pipeline mockup/ui-spec — CẬP NHẬT CÙNG LÚC cả nhóm: Scripts/ui_spec_common.py, ui-spec-validator.py, ui-spec-render.py, ui-review.py, ui-visual-diff.py, ui-build-report.py, ui-kit-sync.py, project_profile.py, UiKit/ui-review-dashboard.template.html, UiKit/kit-preview.template.html, Docs/ui-spec-schema.json, Agents/mockup-drafter. Cài lẻ vẫn chạy an toàn theo cả hai chiều (thiếu bản mới ở bất kỳ script nào → cả pipeline giữ 1080×1920 như cũ) — chỉ đủ nhóm mới có canvas chuẩn 1080×2400 + gate polish; sau khi đủ nhóm chạy lại python3 .claude/scripts/ui-kit-sync.py.

items.name: performance-reviewer
items.description: Mobile-performance reviewer for backlog tasks in this Unity project (mobile-first, Android primary game). Audits a staged diff for GC allocations, hot-path cost, pooling, and rendering/UI overhead, and returns a JSON verdict (pass / warn / block). Does NOT cover code style/conventions (code-reviewer) or security (security-auditor).

items.name: qa-verifier
items.description: Verifies if an implementation in this project has fully resolved the 'Completion Criteria' of the task spec. Reads the staged diff + modified files to cross-check each criterion. Optional: runs runtime checks via Unity MCP if the tool is available. Returns a JSON verdict (pass/warn/fail) and formats a clear list of 'Manual verification steps' for the user to run afterward.

items.name: security-auditor
items.description: Security-audits a diff in this project that touches the backend (Supabase/Cloudflare Worker), IAP/Purchase, save data, or anti-cheat. Returns structured JSON findings. Spawns in parallel with the code-reviewer when a diff touches sensitive files. Does NOT audit code quality (that is the job of the code-reviewer).

items.name: task-planner
items.description: Drafts a backlog task spec (M/L tier) for this Unity project (mobile-first). Reads the codebase read-only (NEVER implements, NEVER modifies files) and returns ONE JSON object: files to touch, pattern to follow, scope-control, completion criteria, verify steps, applicable guardrails, mobile impact, and open questions. Spawned by the /planning-task skill for M/L tiers only.

items.name: ui-visual-reviewer
items.description: Independent visual/structural reviewer for UI prefabs built via the /new-ui (and /new-package UI branch) workflow — phase checkpoints A/B/C plus the Phase D designer pass (overlay art/FX/motion on a frozen layout) — or reworked via /refactor-ui, Unity MCP. Captures its OWN screenshot of the SAME live Unity instance the builder used — never trusts the builder's screenshot — and checks it against a reference image or the numeric spec-sheet from new-ui-guide.md §0, the project's art style (ArtStyle.md: approved/rejected screen images + the §11 checklist), the shared PolishRules checklist (text/touch-target floors, at most one primary CTA, state legibility, empty states), plus the workflow's hard structural rules (layout-mode exclusivity, content containment, missing references, localize registration). Returns a JSON verdict (pass/block) with concrete per-finding evidence. Read-only — does NOT build or fix anything.

items.name: add-localize
items.description: Add one or a handful of NEW localization keys you already know the wording for - the EZG MCP tool localize_add_keys writes the row into the team sheet (English + Vietnamese by hand, the other 14 languages machine-translated through the sheet's `template` staging tab, with EZG's shared service account - no key file), then the skill's script merges just those keys into the project's LocalizationData CSVs and runtime .assets. Any batch size - the tool works in short rounds the agent repeats on its own. Use when asked to "thêm key localize", "thêm key <x> vào sheet", "tạo key localize mới", "add a localize key", "add a new localization key", "cần key dịch cho nút này". NOT an audit tool - it never scans screens for hardcoded text, never decides key names for strings it was not given, and never touches prefabs; a sweep over screens is `fill-localize`.

items.name: add-to-backlog
items.description: Pick one or more tasks from backlog/planning/ into BACKLOG.md (assign NNN, move planning → todo, insert bullet). Bare invocation (no args) auto-picks ALL planning tasks. Used when the user says "add task to backlog" / "pick task to backlog" / "promote task". To CREATE a new task spec, use /planning-task. When intent is unclear between the two skills, confirm with the user first.

items.name: auto-clear
items.description: Push the session's work via /push-in-session, then automatically /clear the very Claude Code session that is running right after the turn ends — only after the push is the flag set for the exact iTerm2 pane (macOS) / Windows Terminal console (Windows, experimental); a Stop hook reads the flag and types "/clear" + Enter into that exact pane. Use when the user says "/auto-clear", "xong việc thì tự clear", "clear sau khi xong", "auto clear when done", "clear after finishing", or the prompt/goal has a "/clear" step after completion. "/auto-clear # UI:" to set the commit prefix + tag, "/auto-clear off" to cancel, "/auto-clear install" to register the hook on a new machine.

items.name: auto-test-device
items.description: QA agent that plays the game on a device like a normal player to test ONE feature in depth — visuals and logic — then LOGS BUGS ITSELF to BugHub via the Bug Logger contract (screenshot + log + auto-generated repro steps, de-duplicated). Works on ANY repo from the EZG template - project conventions (screen enum, UI base class, cheats, PlayerData, CSV) come from `.claude/project-profile.json["qa"]` + `.claude/docs/QaProfile.md`, auto-detected by `profile init` when missing; knowledge learned each session (live screens, verified cheat/state paths, noise rules) is written back there. Devices - Android via adb (USB or emulator, AVD booted by name), iOS Simulator, real iPhone, Unity Editor (EZG QA Probe in the build). A new machine / project needs ONE sentence - `doctor` + STEP 0 handle the rest - update the related Feature Hub items (this skill, probe, autotest, cheat-gate, buglogger) via MCP ezg, run /bughub-setup in-session when BugHub is missing (asks only for the Discord forum ID if the project is unregistered), install the API-retry hook, add the probe to the manifest, install the app, open the game; a release build with com.ezg.cheat-gate on a device not in the test list gets added via test_device_add (Lead/QA account). Flow - doctor/selfcheck → import Editor autotest results → charter with case IDs (in the repo, `.claude/docs/qa/charters/`) → play case by case with explicit expectations (`tap --expect`), auto audit on each screen change → logic oracles from CSV/state/tracking/save-migration → environment matrix (font size, dark mode, aspect, pseudo-loc, interruptions) → log bugs → coverage + report. "Whole game" → `plan` groups by bucket/feature ordered by risk, one charter per group, in turn. Errors never stop the task - Claude API errors auto-resume every 30s via the /auto-clear hook, transient device/network errors rerun via `retry`. Use when the user types "/auto-test-device <device id> <tính năng>", "chạy auto test <device id>", "chạy auto test full game", "auto test toàn bộ game", says "auto test trên máy", "test tính năng X trên device/điện thoại/emulator", "chơi thử rồi log bug", "QA tự động trên thiết bị", "run auto test on <device>", "auto test the whole game", "play it and log bugs". Missing BugHub → run /bughub-setup, do not stop. Does NOT write C# autotest scenarios (→ ezg-autotest-scenario), does NOT fix bugs (→ /fix-bug).

items.name: backend-communication
items.description: Client-backend communication using Supabase (direct read) and Cloudflare Workers (validated write) via GameNetworkManager. Use when a feature reads server data, upserts/deletes records, or claims rewards with server-side validation.

items.name: base-notification
items.description: Guide for creating notification indicators (red dots) by inheriting RedDotBadge over the reusable BaseRedDot package.

items.name: blender-rig-animate
items.description: Rig, skin, pose và animate nhân vật, quái, prop, xe 3D bằng Blender headless (rigkit) cho Unity, có lò xo theo đà (follow-through) và gate đo từng frame: weight, giới hạn khớp, xuyên người, vật cứng xuyên sàn, trượt chân, loop, pose trung tâm, biên độ; xuất FBX kèm AnimationEvent. Spec của từng nhân vật để trong project game, cạnh model. Cần Blender 4.2+ trên máy. items.name: create-sfx

Chỉ khi máy **chưa cài / chưa đăng nhập** MCP `ezg-sfx` (hoặc MCP lỗi, hoặc tìm không ra âm đạt) mới tổng hợp 100% bằng code (numpy + scipy, không AI audio, không tốn tiền, không cần mạng) với 26 recipe × 10 nguyên tố (neutral, fire, gold, frost, arcane, toxic, holy, shadow, electric, rose). Gồm âm UI (click, select, popup mở/đóng, whoosh, tick, coin, error, unlock, reward, level up, fanfare) và âm gameplay (bắn/projectile, cast/charge, trúng đòn, chém, nổ, sét, băng vỡ, lửa phụt, hồi máu, triệu hồi, aura loop), nhiều biến thể cho âm phát liên tục, độ to theo chuẩn mobile hoặc theo âm có sẵn của game khai ở ArtStyle.md §6c. Hai nguồn cùng qua một QA tự động (độ to, cụt đuôi, click, onset trễ, mất tiếng trên loa điện thoại, chồng âm khi cảnh đông, license) + ảnh review waveform/spectrogram đặt cạnh âm gốc + file nghe A/B. Xuất WAV + .meta đúng chuẩn import (Vorbis, Decompress On Load, giữ GUID khi làm lại) vào `<sfxRoot>/<Name>/`, gắn thẳng vào field `SoundConfig` (OpenPopup, ClosePopup, ButtonSelect, PurchaseItem…) hoặc vào list `SoundPlayController` của com.ezg.audio trên prefab (pool biến thể + cooldown chống chồng, play on enable). items.name: fix-bug
items.description: Pull bugs QA logged through Bug Logger (BugHub server → GitLab Issue + Discord thread) and fix them — every bug-lifecycle action goes ONLY through the MCP tools `bughub_*` (get/next/claim/resolve/needs_info/block/release/people), never GitLab/Discord directly. Opens the Unity Editor before claiming, fixes, mandatory /compile-check (no blind push), /push-in-session # with a `Bug-Report: #N` line, bughub_resolve with a Vietnamese summary + before / after screenshots when the bug is visible on screen (the issue STAYS OPEN for QA to verify — never closed), then cleans the working tree (every change not in the bug's commit — junk the Unity Editor writes such as TMP font atlases, materials… — goes to a backup ref and returns to HEAD; the bot branch cleans everything, a checkout shared with the dev keeps the WIP that existed at claim time) before the next bug, then /auto-clear. Someone presses "Huỷ & hoàn tác" mid-way → the bot stops at the next checkpoint and restores the folder to its claim-time state (the server already reverted pushed commits). One commit per bug, one clean session per bug. "/fix-bug 12" fixes exactly bug #12, "/fix-bug" takes the next bug (both commit to the current branch), "/fix-bug --watch" waits for new bugs (token-free polling script) → merges the branch's origin (bot branch: also the main branch, conflicts merged keeping both sides — when one side must win, the main branch wins) → opens the Editor → fixes → pushes → closes the bot-opened Editor once no retry bug is left → clears → waits again, NEVER stops by itself (any error pauses 30 seconds then retries, unlimited; started via `bughub-watch.py start`, a claude crash or a stall over 20 minutes (watchdog) also relaunches it and the new session resumes the bug in progress); all modes: BugHub server / network errors and Claude's own API errors (e.g. "organization has disabled Claude subscription access") retry every 30 seconds, unlimited (macOS iTerm2 + Windows Terminal); watch fixes + pushes to the branch it runs on, unless the project declares a bot branch `bugHub.watch.branch` in project-profile.json. Use when the user says "fix bug 12", "fix bug #12", "/fix-bug", "fix bug QA log", "sửa bug tester log", "chờ bug mới rồi fix", "watch bug", "fix the bugs testers logged", "wait for new bugs and fix them".

items.name: run-backlog
items.description: Autonomous backlog agent for this Unity project — pick the first task in TODO, implement it, run quality gates (code-reviewer + performance-reviewer when perf-sensitive + security-auditor when sensitive, in parallel + qa-verifier) with auto-fix max 2 rounds per gate, mark it DONE, and commit + push to the work branch in the project's push-in-session style — only this task's files, `<prefix> Tag: <subject>` message (current mode: the branch already checked out; worktree mode: agent/dev-<base>). DO NOT create PRs. Under the loop runner a blocked/failed iteration is self-healed: the next iteration resumes the task in recovery mode (1f), and a task that still cannot finish is parked so the loop goes on.

items.name: setup-package-push
items.description: One-time, per-machine setup that lets /package-module push to the ezg-packages monorepo over SSH instead of a GitHub PAT. Checks/installs the GitHub CLI (gh), runs its one-time browser login (gh auth login --git-protocol ssh --web), generates an SSH key if the machine doesn't have one, registers it on the user's GitHub account (gh ssh-key add), and verifies both SSH auth to github.com and Write access to PackageStore/ezg-packages. Idempotent — safe to re-run, exits early if everything already works. Used when the user says "setup package push", "cài SSH cho package-module", "tôi chưa có SSH", "cấp quyền deploy package không cần PAT". Requires the user already has (or an admin has granted) GitHub Write access to PackageStore/ezg-packages — this skill cannot grant that, only prove/verify it.

items.name: setup-project
items.description: Setup một project Unity vừa sinh từ template — mở cửa sổ Ezg > EzgKit (menu trái là các mục setup có trạng thái, form bên phải để điền) rồi làm phần cần AI mà form không tự làm được (soạn ArtStyle.md từ art của game, kiểm tra link localize). Dùng khi dev gõ /setup-project, nói "setup project mới", "điền bundle id / marketing / ads / localize cho project", hoặc hỏi project còn thiếu setup gì. Chạy tay, KHÔNG đi qua backlog.

items.name: time-manager
items.description: Guide for using TimeManager module for time operations, period checks, and online time synchronization.

items.name: ui-cooldown-time-view
items.description: Display countdown timers (cooldowns) on the UI via UI_CooldownTimeView. Use for event end-times, IAP pack timers, or fixed daily/weekly/monthly rollovers shown on a UI Text.

items.name: ui-kit
items.description: Own the UI-kit contract that every mockup and /new-ui build reads — regenerate it from the screen template prefabs (ui-kit-sync.py), check whether it is stale (--check), and record composition rules a prefab cannot express in ui-kit-usage.json. Use when a template prefab under uiTemplatesRoot is added/renamed/edited, when the ui-spec validator reports kit_stale or unknown_template, when a review catches a mockup composing templates wrongly, or when the user says "sync ui kit" / "update ui kit" / "kit stale".

items.name: ui-manager
items.description: UI system management - show/hide/layer control via UIManager. Use when opening/closing feature screens or popups, controlling UI layers/containers, queueing UI sequences, or locking touch input. Never use gameObject.SetActive on feature UI.

items.name: ui-motion
items.description: Motion, sfx, feedback cho UI uGUI theo role bằng module UI Motion và quy chuẩn đi kèm module, dùng cho mọi project: khảo sát project, sinh luật riêng (ProjectSettings/UIMotionProject.json + .md), gắn motion cho prefab, chạy gate M-1…M-12, đưa module vào project cũ. Mang sẵn quy chuẩn UI Motion (docs/ trong skill): đọc được luật cả khi project chưa có module. Gắn motion vào prefab thì cần module UIMotion trong project (tab Unity Packages > EZG Shared > UIMotion); script khảo sát cần Node 18+.

items.name: update-ai
items.description: Cập nhật toàn bộ AI dùng chung (skill, command, agent, rule, docs, script, CLAUDE.md, settings) từ Feature Hub bằng MỘT lệnh /update-ai mà không mất phần project đã tuỳ biến: so 3 chiều với bản gốc, cập nhật file project chưa sửa, gộp JSON settings/.mcp.json, chuyển phần project lỡ sửa thẳng vào file base sang override rồi mới nhận bản mới, cài item mới, commit local. Kèm hook chặn sửa nhầm file base. Project cũ: cài item này một lần (tab AI Feature, hoặc bảo Claude "cài skill update-ai từ Feature Hub") rồi gõ /update-ai.

items.name: validate-release
items.description: Kiểm tra toàn bộ setting + tích hợp SDK của project Unity mobile đã sẵn sàng release chưa — bundle id, keystore/signing, Firebase, Ads/mediation, AppsFlyer/Facebook, Remote Config, build settings, cờ debug còn bật, secrets, localization, hằng số sót lại từ project cũ. Chạy deterministic bằng Python thuần, KHÔNG cần Unity Editor và KHÔNG cần MCP. Dùng khi user nói "check release", "validate release", "project đã sẵn sàng build chưa", "kiểm tra SDK đã cài đủ chưa", "còn thiếu gì để lên store", hoặc trước khi bấm build production. KHÔNG phải tool build (build CI đi qua EZG MCP `autobuild_*`) và KHÔNG phải compile check (đó là /compile-check).
